title: Octopus board: named terminal → destination
scope: Production Octopus Pro v1.1 / STM32F429 with four external CL57T V4.1 drives. Functional names, not a physical mating-face pinout or a complete cabinet power design.

sourceBoard.title: BIGTREETECH Octopus Pro V1.1-Pin — 2023-11-02
sourceBoard.distribution: External official reference; image bytes are not bundled in the public build.

instructions: Keep all supplies and USB isolated and discharged while preparing or changing wiring.
Match the actual board revision, printed names, connector viewing side and continuity. A GPIO or schematic contact number is not a physical cavity position.
Planned interfaces remain on HOLD until actual modules, terminals and electrical behavior are proved. No status in this file records completed hardware acceptance.

groups.title: TB / T0 / T1: safety monitor, hold and probe

rows.destination: Isolated safety-relay monitor contact that is closed while the relay is energized and opens on E-stop/trip (not an NC auxiliary); relay terminal HOLD.
Verified return for that monitor contact.
NC feed-hold button contact.
Verified return for the feed-hold contact.
Qualified isolated touch-probe conditioner output; actual module terminal not assigned.
Verified controller-side probe-conditioner return.

notes: SAFE-MON reports the safety relay; it does not replace the independent hardware stop. PF3 high means E-stop, so a wrong (NC auxiliary) contact inverts the reading; never invert $14 to compensate. Feed hold is not energy isolation.
PROBE-01 is the sensor-to-interface cable. The separate interface-to-T1 output harness still needs its own ID and terminal map.
No probe field supply or raw sensor output goes directly to PF5. T2 and T3 are unused.

groups.title: EXP2: aggregate fault and cycle start

rows.destination: Qualified supervised combined healthy output from the fault conditioner.
Verified controller-side aggregate return.
NO guarded cycle-start contact.
Verified cycle-start contact return.
Leave unconnected for this design.

notes: PB1 is the configured controller motor-fault input: all required contributors healthy = low; fault/open cable/lost power must make it high.
Every raw CL57T ALM/COMO pair first goes to its own isolated, current-limited and supervised conditioner. No raw transistor series chain or raw alarm GPIO connection.
Include required spindle/cabinet fault contributors. PB1 remains separate from the independent hardwired safety chain.
Use a verified keyed breakout and recorded return paths, not generic IDC pin numbering.
PB1 and PB2 have no board pull-up or RC filter (BTT v1.1 schematic). The interface board supplies series resistor, TVS, 3.3 V pull-up and RC.

PB2 is net BTN_EN1, shared with the onboard SW2 (BOOT1) button to GND; pressing SW2 is a cycle start and can resume a feed hold. Guard or remove SW2 before commissioning. EXP2 pin 8 is the MCU reset line (RST) beside these contacts.
